text: Friday, late. Day four of being locked out of my exchange account. On Monday the app asked me to verify my identity again, I uploaded my passport photo twice, and both times it said 'document unreadable'. My account email is lorena.fischer@mailbox.example.invalid and the exchange shows user ID CX-7751-3092, which I have typed into support forms about nine times by now. Ticket 2 got an auto-reply promising an answer within 48 hours, ticket 5 got nothing, and the live chat said my case is number 31 in the queue. I have roughly 0.85 BTC and 4,200 euros of stablecoins stuck in there, and I do not even know whether I am allowed to ask for a manual review. The 2FA codes still arrive on my phone, +49 151 5550 2764, so at least that works. Tomorrow I will write a proper complaint with a clear timeline.
